description: One weekly window for every update, early on Monday morning, and lock file maintenance on the first day of the month, in `Europe/Berlin`. A repository's own top-level `schedule` replaces the weekly window. Schedules are deliberately not set per dependency type: `group-non-major` puts every type into one branch, and a group whose members carry different schedules waits on "Awaiting Schedule" instead of opening.

schedule: before 3am on the first day of the month
